name: Pókaszepetk (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and green at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Pókaszepetk: a blue, white and green shield with a bough, ears of grain, a church and stars.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
